nodes.label: SponsorX Core Loop
nodes.rationale: BUSINESS wants customers → BTG matches athletes → ATHLETE posts real content → FAN scans QR reward & buys → BTG measures → SPONSOR gets ROI report → renews. A real B2B platform (not a game, not collectible cards) — comparable to LinkedIn + Fiverr + an Ads Manager + a CRM.

nodes.label: Three User Portals
nodes.rationale: Sponsor (business buying campaigns), Athlete / Content Partner (builds profile, accepts jobs, posts, gets paid), Admin / BTG staff (approvals, matching, content approval, rewards, finance, reports).

nodes.label: NIL Jobs SX-01 – SX-07
nodes.rationale: Story Drop → Monthly Ambassador; each has an athlete base pay and a sponsor sell price — the gap is BTG's margin.

nodes.label: Sponsor Packages
nodes.rationale: $750 Test Drive (cheap on purpose, low-friction first buy) → Local Blitz → Community → Takeover → Season Partner ($15K–30K+).

nodes.label: Athlete Tiers
nodes.rationale: Emerging 1.0× → Creator 1.25× → Premium 1.5× → Anchor custom multipliers on base rates.

nodes.label: Content Value Score
nodes.rationale: Engagement, quality, reliability, geography, fit — deliberately NOT primarily follower count.

nodes.label: CPM Pricing Formula
nodes.rationale: Base CPM × engagement × audience quality × geography × format × exclusivity × demand × confidence; fixed-price jobs still compute an implied CPM for learning.

nodes.label: QR Reward Funnel
nodes.rationale: scan → landing → claim → redemption, each tracked as a separate event; claims become opted-in fan leads handed to the sponsor. Privacy-sensitive — consent required, often youth sports.

nodes.label: Zoho CRM Integration (Dual System of Record)
nodes.rationale: Zoho = system of record for sales/pipeline/invoices; SponsorX = system of record for athletes, campaigns, deliverables, performance. Sync via external IDs + retry queue to avoid drift/duplicates.

nodes.label: Four-Phase Product Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 managed micro-NIL marketplace (real campaigns run partly by hand, software records everything) → Phase 2 transactional marketplace/payments/Wallet → Phase 3 intelligence (pricing, matching, forecasting, attribution) → Phase 4 INFINEX virtual sponsorship inventory.
